pixel_selection_bound.basis: Conservative +/-2 original pixels per selected axis coordinate, covering the approximately 3-5-pixel tick-stroke width and manual centre selection/antialiasing ambiguity. Zero-based top-left origin, x rightwards and y downwards. Mid-stroke centres of labelled -3/+3 ticks on the bottom axis of the LEFT Ref. subpanel and -45/+45 ticks on its left axis; not plot borders. Original-size crops and dark-stroke pixel runs were inspected after verifying the original raster hash. This is an extraction selection bound, not a fitted standard deviation, measurement uncertainty, or 2%-of-Ps error. Marker selection requires separate documentation and independent visual review; this profile contains no digitized polarization samples.
